dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible multiple irregular, closed and semi-closed light-intensity perimeters forming 'O' and 'C' shapes. These structures exhibit a sharp contrast gradient between a thin, high-intensity light outer boundary and a significantly darker low-intensity interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical, solid high-intensity pixel clusters. These clusters lack internal gradients and are predominantly located along the dorsal ridge and scattered across the posterior lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-section form an obtuse triangle. Connecting these with the centroids of two dorsal high-intensity blobs creates a complex five-point irregular polygon with varied interior angles.
